## Summary

Describe the change and the user or developer impact.

## Why

Explain the problem, root cause or opportunity this addresses.

## Validation

List the exact checks performed, including relevant QGIS versions.

## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] Inputs and outputs remain typed and bounded.
- [ ] No arbitrary Python execution or unintended credential exposure was introduced.
- [ ] Mutations retain revision, idempotency and confirmation controls where applicable.
- [ ] QGIS 3.44 LTR and QGIS 4 / Qt 6 compatibility was considered.
- [ ] Tests and documentation were updated.
- [ ] The branch contains no unrelated files or generated secrets.

## Screenshots or artifacts

Add sanitized visual evidence when the change affects QGIS UI, rendering or layouts.
